description: Multi-dimensional fraud detection and risk assessment engine that evaluates loan applicants for fraudulent behavior, synthetic identities, velocity abuse, device fingerprinting anomalies, and blacklist matches. Uses machine learning models combined with rule-based checks to produce a risk score and recommended action. Commonly integrated before loan disbursal to prevent first-party fraud, identity theft, mule account activity, and coordinated fraud rings. Also used in real-time transaction monitoring.
use_cases: Pre-disbursal fraud screening for personal and business loans
Synthetic identity detection for new applicant onboarding
Device fingerprint and IP reputation scoring
Velocity check for repeated applications from same device or identity
High-risk application routing to manual review
compliance_context: Supports RBI fraud monitoring requirements and PMLA obligations. Audit logs all risk decisions for regulatory review.
typical_callers: Lending platforms, digital banks, BNPL providers, insurance underwriters, payment processors screening high-value transactions
auth_description: Bearer token authentication. Static or rotating bearer token passed in Authorization header.

required_fields.description: Unique applicant or session tracking ID for velocity correlation
Customer PAN for identity cross-reference and blacklist check
Mobile number for velocity and telecom-based risk signals
Originating IP address for geolocation and IP reputation check
Hardware and browser hash for device identity tracking
Requested loan principal for amount-based risk calibration

optional_fields.description: Email address for breach database and dark web check
Self-employed or Salaried for income-risk calibration
Current address PIN for geographic risk profiling
Previously fetched bureau score as an additional risk signal

error_codes.400: Invalid IP or missing required fields.
error_codes.403: Token lacks permission for risk evaluate.
